<section class="project-section">

        Housing Capitalization, Spatial Spillovers, and Distributional Effects

      </p>
      <p class="project-description">

        into nearby housing values, how far their effects extend across space, and
        how benefits and costs are distributed across neighborhoods with different
        income levels, tenure structures, and social vulnerability.
      </p>
